As an inanimate report of natural phenomena, this lacks a human operator for moral weighting or intentional extraction.
Heavy rains in southern China are forecasted to increase the risk of flash floods and damage to rice crops over the next week, threatening agricultural output.

The Bright Side:
Early warning systems allow for preparation and mitigation, potentially shifting the p·t toward better outcomes through human intervention.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is an Object State. Q1 (WHO) and Q4 (WHY) are blanked. The focus is purely on the physical (WHERE) and causal (CAUSE) planes of the event.

The Trajectory: Neutral.

...it remains in the Neutral zone. It is a tool for observation and prediction, not an act of will or a structural extraction of value.

The Unavoidable Truth: Natural cycles operate independently of human desire.

The Unavoidable Lie: That we can perfectly control the impact of extreme weather events.
